* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-2021-09-03-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Light: If opponent's [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and Force drain +2 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Coruscant: The Works (Errata)]]): Card image published 21 April 2022<ref name="img-2022-04-21-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif</code> as published 21 April 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3f7288d580f892a638c6e3b78ca43474ade7756a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable commit 3f7288d] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here. Light: -” '''What changed:''' Light Side text “If opponent's [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and Force drain +2 here.” became “-”. Dark Side text “May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” became “May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here.”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Coruscant: The Works (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 11 June 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-2022-06-11-1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif</code> as published 11 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/coruscanttheworks.gif holotable commit 6894629] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Dark: May deploy non-[Theed Palace] Sidious here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your [Special Edition] objective on table, gains one [Light Side] icon and opponent's Force drains are +2 here. Light: -” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the GIF at a larger size (745×534 → 1039×745 pixels) with its new GIF maker (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”, which re-made 51 landscape card images that day; the new file is PNG data kept under the <code>.gif</code> name); it is the same card enlarged, with the same rounded transparent corners — words, art, layout and errata mark are unchanged. A visible (resolution) change, so a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: re-renders and resolution changes are versions).
